issues_detected.title: Rust and Leakage on Water Heater
issues_detected.description: The water heater shows significant rust and evidence of leakage at the bottom, indicating potential corrosion and failure.
issues_detected.recommendation: Immediate inspection by a licensed plumber is recommended. Consider replacing the water heater to prevent further damage and potential water damage to surrounding areas.

analysis.overall_assessment: The water heater is in poor condition with visible rust and leakage, requiring urgent attention.
